title: did/0.1
description: Profile for heterogeneity-robust difference-in-differences and event-study estimators with staggered treatment timing: Stata csdid and did2s; R did (att_gt, aggte) and did2s; Python pyfixest did2s (survey 2026-10-25, spec/profiles/did.md). Requires meta.estimator.method; specification.did with the time variable, the comparison group and the cohort (first-treated period) or treatment indicator; metrics.nobs; estimate and std_error on every row that isn't dropped; a default vcov with type; and a `did` object on at least one row saying which treatment effect the row is (att_gt, event, group, calendar, simple, pre_avg, post_avg). conf_low/conf_high are pointwise; uniform bands go in the row's did.band_low/band_high. structures.did (cohort sizes, pre-trend test, uniform-band critical value, per-cell sample sizes) is expected, not required. Does not build on inference/0.1: csdid, R did and Stata did2s use normal inference with no residual df, and csdid's wild bootstrap reports no p-values. Records that meet inference/0.1 too (R and pyfixest did2s) claim both.

outcome_model.description: How the 2x2 comparisons adjust for covariates (Callaway-Sant'Anna). csdid method(), R did est_method.

nobs.description: Rows used, as in the core. R did reports units, not rows: its n goes in n_units.

x-tools.did: rows of the data used (n is units in a panel)

n_cohorts.description: Treated cohorts (distinct first-treated periods), not counting never-treated.

n_never_treated.description: Never-treated units (rows, for repeated cross sections).

n_not_identified.description: Rows dropped because their counterfactual is not identified (no untreated observations in their fixed-effect level).

vcov.description: At most one vcov is the default; the default (or a lone vcov) needs type. ssc is recommended: record {convention, formula: "none"} when the tool applies no correction.

x-tools.csdid: influence_function, or wild_bootstrap when e(vcetype) is "WBoot"
x-tools.did: multiplier_bootstrap (bstrap = TRUE, the default) or influence_function

design.description: The DiD design as specified, resolved.

unit.description: Unit identifier; null for repeated cross sections.

cohort.description: Variable holding each unit's first treated period (0 or missing for never-treated, as the tool codes it).

never_treated_code.description: Value of the cohort variable that marks never-treated units.

panel.description: true for a panel, false for repeated cross sections.

balanced.description: Whether an unbalanced panel was allowed (false) or balanced first (true).

comparison.description: Which observations serve as controls. never_treated: units never treated in the sample; not_yet_treated: never-treated plus units not yet treated at t; untreated: every untreated observation (imputation estimators).

anticipation.description: Periods of anticipation allowed before treatment.

base_period.description: Pre-period comparisons: varying (t-1 vs t) or universal (g-1-anticipation for every t).

x-tools.csdid: e(typebase): default = varying; long/long2 compare with g-1 (record the option too)

did_row.description: Which treatment effect a parameter row is. Rows without it (covariates in a did2s second stage, for example) are not treatment effects.

x-tools.csdid: agg(): attgt, event (Tm#/Tp#, Pre_avg/Post_avg), group, calendar, simple (ATT)
x-tools.did: att_gt rows; aggte type dynamic = event, group, calendar, simple
x-tools.did2s: event when the second stage is relative-time dummies, simple for a single treatment dummy

event_time.description: Periods relative to treatment, e = t - g (event). A binned endpoint keeps its edge value and sets binned.

binned.description: The row pools event times beyond event_time.

weight.description: Aggregation weight of this row in the overall ATT, when the tool reports it.

band_low.description: Lower end of the simultaneous (uniform) confidence band.

test.description: A test statistic, as in iv/0.1.

vcov.description: vcov type the statistic uses, when it differs from the default vcov.

did_structure.description: Design and diagnostics of a DiD run: counts, never the unit ids.

cohorts.description: One entry per cohort in the sample, never-treated included (cohort null or the tool's code, never_treated true).

cells.description: Per (cohort, period) 2x2 comparison: the rows behind each ATT(g,t).

x-tools.csdid: e(gtt): cohort t0 t1 error N N_cntr N_trt

error.description: The tool's return code for the cell (csdid _rc), 0 when it estimated.

pretrend.description: Joint test that the pre-treatment effects are zero.

x-tools.did: W, Wpval (summary: "P-value for pre-test of parallel trends assumption")

uniform_band.description: The simultaneous confidence band behind parameters[*].did.band_low/band_high.
